slides.title: Building a Better Bangladesh Through Compassion
slides.subtitle: Mother Ayesha Foundation is dedicated to healthcare, education, research, skills development, and social welfare for underprivileged communities across Bangladesh.

slides.title: Empowering Communities Through Education & Skills
slides.subtitle: From scholarships and TVET institutes to financial literacy — we equip people with the tools to build self-sufficient, dignified lives.

slides.title: Quality Healthcare for Every Community
slides.subtitle: We establish clinics, hospitals, eye care facilities, and elderly care programs to serve those most in need across Bangladesh.

slides.title: Research-Driven Solutions for Sustainable Development
slides.subtitle: We connect academia, industry, and government to drive evidence-based policy change aligned with UN SDG 2030 goals.

focus.heading: Our Focus Areas
focus.description: We provide comprehensive support to communities in Bangladesh through these key programs derived from our Memorandum of Association.

mission.heading: Transforming lives through education, health, and research.
mission.point1Desc: Charitable, non-political support for underprivileged communities and peoples of Bangladesh on a strictly non-profit basis.
mission.point2Desc: Research-backed programs aligned with the UN SDG 2030 objectives including climate, health, and financial inclusion.
mission.quote: Through your generosity, we build pathways to education, healthcare, vocational skills, and economic opportunity. We work with communities, government, and academia to create lasting, sustainable change across Bangladesh.
mission.quoteStrong: Together, we can create a Bangladesh where every person has the opportunity to thrive.
